title: The Maltese Falcon — an office consultation
author: Dashiell Hammett

source.startAnchor: “What does he do for a living?” Spade asked
source.endAnchor: “And don’t look for me,” Archer cautioned her. “I’ll see you all right.”
source.normalization: UTF-8; CRLF to LF; soft line wraps joined with spaces; paragraph breaks and all wording retained.

instructions.narrator: A clear, measured adult male American audiobook narrator. Neutral scene description with natural sentence pacing; no exaggerated drama.
instructions.spade: An adult male American detective speaking with calm, dry confidence and clipped conversational phrasing. Original synthetic character, not an imitation of an actor.
instructions.wonderly: An adult American woman with a soft clear voice, controlled anxiety and polite, increasingly urgent appeals. Natural conversational delivery without breathy whispering.

spans.speaker: spade
spans.text: “What does he do for a living?”

spans.speaker: narrator
spans.text: Spade asked as he laid down his pencil.

spans.speaker: spade
spans.text: “What time is he coming to see you?”

spans.speaker: spade
spans.text: “All right, Miss Wonderly, we’ll have a man there. It’ll help if—”

spans.speaker: wonderly
spans.text: “Mr. Spade, could either you or Mr. Archer?”

spans.speaker: narrator
spans.text: She made an appealing gesture with both hands.

spans.speaker: wonderly
spans.text: “Could either of you look after it personally? I don’t mean that the man you’d send wouldn’t be capable, but—oh!—I’m so afraid of what might happen to Corinne. I’m afraid of him. Could you? I’d be—I’d expect to be charged more, of course.”

spans.speaker: narrator
spans.text: She opened her handbag with nervous fingers and put two hundred-dollar bills on Spade’s desk.

spans.speaker: narrator
spans.text: Miss Wonderly stood up, impulsively holding a hand out to him.

spans.speaker: narrator
spans.text: she exclaimed, and then gave Spade her hand, repeating:

spans.speaker: spade
spans.text: “Glad to. It’ll help some if you either meet Thursby downstairs or let yourself be seen in the lobby with him at some time.”

spans.speaker: narrator
spans.text: she promised, and thanked the partners again.
